_comment: Scheme-level assets under management in INR CRORE, MONTH-END (never average AUM), keyed by AMFI scheme code: { "SIF-3": [ { "month": "2026-08", "aumCr": 1234.56, "src": "<sourceId>", "locator": "...", "verified": true } ] }. `src` names an entry in `sources`. Only verified entries are read. AMC, industry and per-strategy totals are DERIVED in lib/data/aum.ts from one common month, with completeness flags — never store a total here. Check the unit on every read: factsheets mix lakh and crore.
